form.seasonYearAuto: Set by the occasion that's open
form.remarkPlaceholder: e.g. some damaged cards taken off the shelf

banner.noSupplierBody: Choose a supplier to see each occasion's status and enter quantities.
banner.filledBody: Last quantities are filled in. Only change the rows that are different, then tap Overwrite. This submission replaces the last one.
banner.pendingBody: Enter the remaining quantity for each price and submit them all at once.
banner.staleBody: Your quantities are kept and "Last" now shows the newest figures. Please check before submitting.
banner.noOpenTitle: No occasion is open for submission now
banner.noOpenRule: Each occasion is open for submission for 4 weeks from the day itself (29 days in total). Outside that window you can only view history.

confirm.title: Overwrite the last submission?
confirm.note: The last submission stays in History; reports use this one. Blank prices count as 0.

history.tableHint: The table adds up each supplier's latest submission.

errors.customUnitPrice: Other price has a quantity; enter an actual unit price above 0
errors.remainingQuantity: Remaining quantity must be a whole number of 0 or more
errors.noChanges: Quantities match the last submission; nothing to submit
errors.catalogChanged: The price list has changed. Pull to refresh and fill it in again
errors.supplierNotFound: This supplier no longer exists or is disabled. Please choose another
errors.forbiddenStore: You can't submit for this store
errors.windowClosed: This occasion is no longer open for submission

messages.noAccessDescription: Your account does not have permission to view or submit seasonal cards.
messages.overwriteSuccess: Last submission overwritten; reports now use this one
messages.staleSnackbar: Someone just updated this submission. The comparison is refreshed; please check before submitting
messages.supplierLoadFailed: Could not load suppliers. Pull to refresh and try again
messages.detailLoadFailedDescription: The record details are unavailable right now.
messages.emptyHistoryDescription: There are no seasonal card submissions for the current filters.
messages.catalogEmpty: No seasonal card price list is available right now
